description:
Lisa Martelly stopped by The Current's Morning Show to talk about Uptown Porchfest. The festival is taking place this Saturday, August 15 from 1pm-6pm, along porches and yards all across Uptown, Minneapolis.

Find more information at uptownporchfest.com

author: The Current
description:
José González describes fika, the Swedish coffee break
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

During a visit to The Current studio, Swedish singer-songwriter José González took a moment to talk about the coffee break tradition known as fika, something that is unique to Sweden, and how it fits into his typical day.

Watch González's full session at The Current here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g7BUW4QppdM

José González’s 2026 album, Against the Dying of the Light, is available on Mute Records @themutechannel.
